第二百一十六章 浮光掌门惊鸿一现（第1页）
第二天，两人神清气爽的从客房出来，正准备出发，就听到了另一个消息。
“听说隔壁县的土霸王被灭了满门。”
“谁都没得罪，但他是鲜卑派在中原的探子，刀马堂出动了黑马堂主和红马堂主，各自带着甲字马队，一夜之间就将刘太爷的势力连根拔起。”
经常看到有人骑马在校场奔驰，一队队的，也有一匹一匹的，然而一次温暖的午后，看到有人抱着什么东西慢慢遛马。
这种气势，不是一般的武者能够打出的。想必，窦魁也是觉醒了武魂的武学天才吧。
白九九没有想到这么早竟然开始下雪，在印象当中这是很少的事情，而且这场雪却非常的大。
果不其然，在宫莫良靠近第二栋平房的路上，一道身影从第三栋房子里冲了出来。
程怀弼跳了一会儿，又开始熟练地在院子里打起了虎戏，前扑后纵，虎虎生风，之前因为经脉错乱而产生的钝锉感全部消失，整套动作下来，犹如行云流水一样顺畅无阻。
宫莫良挥手示意李源坐着别动，李源这才又老老实实地坐了回去。
听到户尤说出此话，东方不败战队的几个成员，也都纷纷大笑起来。
不过却毫无发现，根本没看到有人在，虽然如此，但是也能猜测到肯定有人，而人在哪里，自己还没有发现而已。
壮汉也不含糊，左手一把抓住刀右脚猛的一踹，子荣被踹出半米远，他的刀却在壮汉手中。
其他人也没有好到哪里去，一个个的都要应对来自这种未知生物的攻击。
完全没注意到身前出现了一个黑黝黝的身影，惊慌失措的少年撞了个满怀，那被单薄衣物所遮掩着的、犹如磐石一般的身躯令他又颤了颤。
天空之中，朵朵白云从身边飞过，阳光铺满杨边幸福的脸，有种猪八戒回高老庄的喜感。
最后曹鹏发现，或许是现在自己的功力不够，也或许是没有掌握方法，只能暂时性的压制住月痕之力的爆发，却不能彻底的吸收出来。
可是在没真灵之气内功功力的情况下，怎么可能用100散兵闯过700正规编制的盾刀枪箭兵！？

“这是……”杨边两眼放光，看着这两个跟洗剪吹发廊门口挂着的旋转灯差不多得圆柱阵法激动道。
但是周围的恶魔密集度还是太高，这里又是奥拉科特带着他一路挤过来的前排位置，更是多恶魔。
十人队长话还没说完时，西组组长西虎已经举着空壶正在生气半天。
而幽魂山的功法就不用说了，自己身上只有总纲与引气卷，若是想要的话，只能上幽魂山找青衣首座讨要，但是这在左君看来，无异于自寻死路。
连他们老爹得罪都得挨揍，他们要是得罪，就不是挨揍那么简单了。
妖娆一听，也被唬得一愣一愣的，王朗，真的……有这么厉害吗？
他现在越来越怀疑这赵美丽就是韩阳派来整自己的人了，要不然怎么会这么巧的韩阳就出现了，然后还在关键时刻给自己制造麻烦。
“好险。不过从这可以看出，我的脉动一样能够干扰对方的锁定。”刘海惊险躲过一击，心中大喜。
这一切是由高冇自己分析得来，对与不对没关系。反正人家为这四条通道标注的不同的颜色，可能这里的会有四种不同的遭遇。

> Chapter 216: The leader of the Floating Light suddenly appears (page 1)
Chapter 216: The leader of the Floating Light suddenly appears (page 1)
The next day, the two of them came out of the guest room refreshed and were about to set off when they heard another news.
"I heard that the local bullies in the next county were wiped out."
"No one was offended, but he was a spy sent by Xianbei in the Central Plains. The Sword Horse Hall dispatched the Black Horse Hall Master and the Red Horse Hall Master, each with a horse team, uprooting Mr. Liu's influence overnight."
I often see people riding horses galloping around the school grounds, either in teams or one by one. However, one warm afternoon, I saw someone walking the horse slowly while holding something in his arms.
This kind of momentum is not something that ordinary warriors can produce. Presumably, Dou Kui is also a martial arts genius who has awakened his martial soul.
Bai Jiujiu didn't expect it to start snowing so early. In his mind, this was a rare thing, and the snow was very heavy.
Sure enough, as Gong Moliang approached the second bungalow, a figure rushed out of the third house.
Cheng Huaibi danced for a while, and then began to skillfully play tiger tricks in the yard. He jumped forward and backward, and the tiger and tiger made wind. The dull feeling caused by the disordered meridians disappeared, and the whole set of movements was as smooth as flowing water.
Gong Moliang waved his hand to Li Yuan to sit still, and then Li Yuan sat back obediently.
Hearing Huyou say this, several members of the Eastern Undefeated Team also laughed.
However, nothing was found, and no one was seen at all. Even so, he could guess that there must be someone, but he had not discovered where the person was.
The strong man didn't hesitate. He grabbed the knife with his left hand and kicked it hard with his right foot. Zirong was kicked half a meter away, but his knife was in the strong man's hand.
Others are not much better, each one has to deal with attacks from this unknown creature.
He didn't notice at all that a dark figure appeared in front of him. The panicked young man was knocked into his arms. The rock-like body covered by thin clothes made him tremble again.
In the sky, white clouds flew by, and the sunshine covered Yang Bian's happy face, giving him a sense of joy as Zhu Bajie returned to Gao Laozhuang.
In the end, Cao Peng discovered that maybe he didn't have enough skill now, or maybe he didn't master the method. He could only temporarily suppress the explosion of the power of the moon marks, but he couldn't completely absorb it.
But without the inner strength of true spiritual energy, how could 100 skirmishers break through 700 regular formations of shield, sword, gun and archer soldiers! ?
"This is..." Yang Bian's eyes shone, and he said excitedly as he looked at the two cylindrical formations that were similar to the rotating lights hanging at the door of the hair salon.
But the density of demons around him was still too high, and here was the front row position where Oracort had brought him all the way, and there were even more demons.
Before the ten-man captain finished speaking, Xihu, the leader of the Western Group, was already holding an empty pot and was angry for a long time.
Needless to say, there is no need to mention the skills of Ghost Mountain. I only have the General Guide and the Qi Entrainment Scroll on me. If I want it, I can only go to Ghost Mountain to find the Qingyi leader to ask for it. But in Zuo Jun's view, this is tantamount to seeking death.
Even their father had to be beaten if he offended him, but if they offended him, it wasn't as simple as being beaten.
When Yao Luo heard this, she was also stunned. Wang Lang, is it really... so powerful?
He is now increasingly suspicious that Zhao Meili is the person sent by Han Yang to punish him. Otherwise, how could Han Yang appear by such a coincidence, and then cause trouble for him at the critical moment.
"It's so dangerous. But it can be seen from this that my pulse can also interfere with the opponent's lock." Liu Hai narrowly escaped.One blow, my heart was filled with joy.
All this was analyzed by Gao Ye himself, and it doesn’t matter whether it’s right or wrong. Anyway, people have marked these four passages with different colors, so there may be four different encounters here.
